title: Database OOM crash, no restart
reason: The diagnosis correctly points to the PostgreSQL container, a memory‑spike OOM caused by the new analytics query, matching the hidden broken part, problem type, and root cause.
option_titles: Increase DB memory limit and restart
root_cause: The newly deployed analytics dashboard query caused a memory spike that triggered the OOM killer (signal 9) on the PostgreSQL container, which killed the process and corrupted the data directory (missing global/pg_control), preventing the DB from restarting.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced an analytics dashboard query that makes PostgreSQL exceed its 1 GB memory limit; the database was killed (OOM, signal 9) and the container has no restart policy, so it stays down.
check_first: db container logs (docker logs db) and its status (docker ps -a)
